minor.issue: data_inizio matching the regex but not a real date (e.g. '2027-13-45') raises ValueError in date.fromisoformat -> HTTP 500 instead of 400/422. Add a Pydantic field_validator calling date.fromisoformat or catch ValueError -> 400.

Planner projects copied without their planner_bom (distinta materiali), whereas the planner's own 'duplica_da' path calls bom_copy. Consider calling planner_bom copy(org, src_pid, new_pid) for each copied project if BOM should follow.

issues: duplicate-date uses native <input type=date> (browser default picker) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere - minor consistency note
Events list 'Date' column shows 'Evento 18/10' without year, so original 2026 and the new 2027 edition look identical on date; only 'Ed. 2027' distinguishes them
